user.title: Connect to Plex
user.description: The Plex Media Server that Shortlist writes rows to, and the owner's token. In Plex Web open any title, choose Get Info, then View XML: the token is the X-Plex-Token value in the address bar.

data_description.token: Stays on this Home Assistant; posters are proxied so it never reaches a browser.

reauth_confirm.title: Plex token
reauth_confirm.description: {server} rejected the saved token. Paste a new one.

error.cannot_connect: The server did not answer at that address.

abort.already_configured: This Plex server is already set up.

data.players: TVs and players for the Play button
data.continue_watching: Show the owner's Continue watching row
data.recently_added: Show a New on the server row
data.recent_size: Titles in New on the server

data_description.players: Plex clients, Cast devices, Samsung or Android TVs. A Samsung or Android TV is told to open Plex first.
data_description.plex_player_for: One line per TV when the Plex client that appears for it should be named: media_player.tv = media_player.plex_tv
data_description.shortlist_url: Optional, for the last-run sensor: where Shortlist's web interface is, for example http://local-shortlist:5959
data_description.shortlist_token: Optional: Shortlist's owner API token from its Settings

refresh.name: Refresh
